messages:
Ravi (Design): Recap from today's model catalog critique. Two high-priority UX items: presets are buried in the filter drawer (discoverability), and perf badges visually steal attention from model names in compare. Also noticed pin behavior resets across sessions. Quick suggestions below.

Nora (PM): Yep. We've had multiple support asks about presets. Could be hurting adoption of saved views. Proposal: show a compact Presets control above filters with a chevron to manage presets.

Hank (Eng): Implementation caveat: bringing presets above filters changes layout height and could push down the compare header. We can collapse the control on small screens. Backend: if we persist pins, we'll need a simple PUT /api/v1/user/pins endpoint.

Jules (Frontend): On badges: current style uses heavy color + shadow. Users scan for names first; badges should be secondary. My quick CSS idea: `.perf-badge{ background-color:rgba(15,23,42,0.05); border-radius:6px; font-size:11px; padding:4px 8px; box-shadow:none; }` Also suggest aligning badges to the right so names wrap less.

Priya (A11y): A11y items: badges need context for screen readers (not just a number). Add `aria-label="98th percentile latency: 220ms"`. Presets control needs keyboard support and visible focus. Avoid tabindex traps in the filter drawer.

Ravi (Design): For pinning: current tooltip says "Pin" but not persistent. I suggest microcopy: "Pin version (saves this selection to your account)". UX question: pin scope: user-level or team-level? Nora?

Nora (PM): Start with user-level persistence for MVP. Track pin_created and pin_removed events (include model_id, version). Evaluate team-level per customer feedback.

Hank (Eng): Tech plan: store pins in user metadata table. We can fall back to localStorage for anonymous users and migrate on first login. Edge case: model/version retired -> soft-delete pins and surface a notice in the UI.

ci-bot: ci-bot: feature branch `feat/catalog-presets-pin-a11y` built and deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/catalog/compare

Jules (Frontend): Checklist before PR: 1) show presets control in desktop filter rail, 2) move badges to right column and restyle, 3) add focus ring `:focus{ outline:2px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.2); }`, 4) ensure badge buttons have `aria-label`.

Priya (A11y): Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver for the compare table. Make sure screen reader announces row: "Model name, version, performance 98th percentile 220ms, pin button".

Ravi (Design): Quick microcopy proposals: Presets control label "View presets"; tooltip for Apply-to-compare checkbox: "When checked, presets are applied only to the current compare session." Pin tooltip: "Keep this version selected across sessions." Toast when pin missing: "Pinned version not included in current compare."

Nora (PM): I'll draft the Jira with acceptance criteria: presets visible, apply-to-compare toggle, badges de-emphasized, pin persisted per-user, analytics events, A11y tests. Target: ship to staging next Thursday.

Hank (Eng): One more edge-case: when importing saved presets, we should validate that the referenced model IDs still exist. If not, show a clear error in the preset editor.

Jules (Frontend): I'll open the PR after I finish the badge alignment + CSS changes. Will include screenshots and keyboard walkthrough in the PR description.

Ravi (Design): Thanks all. I'll update the Figma and paste a link in the Jira once done. :white_check_mark:
